parameters.name: CustomType
parameters.description:
The type of the baseline check policy that you want to query. Valid values:

*   **common**: standard baseline check policy
*   **custom**: custom baseline check policy

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: StrategyIds
parameters.description: The ID of the baseline check policy that you want to query. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-strategy --source-ip 1.2.X.X --lang zh --strategy-ids 8164248 --custom-type custom --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --CustomType custom --SourceIp '1.2.X.X' --Lang zh --StrategyIds 8164248
